bookmark.return_note: Awaiting field testing with real devices. Mesh protocol spec and security audit needed.

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Mesh relay latency and battery impact.
P.P2_defensibility: P2P offloads server. Encrypted relay. Deterministic ordering.
P4_failure_modes: Relay loop (message bounces) (mitigate: hop limit, seen cache)
P.P5_backup_plan: If mesh fails: revert to server-only connectivity.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Test with multiple devices, various topologies, deliberate failures.
P.P7_testing_strategy: Unit tests for protocol logic. Field tests with 50+ real devices. Stress tests for relay under high load.
P.P8_benchmarks: Relay latency: <5s for 5-hop path. Battery impact: <5% per hour relay. Message delivery: 95%+ reliability.

CH1_change_log.description: Initial placeholder CONFolder for mesh module

L.L3_consent_requirements: User must consent to relay participation (battery impact).
L.L4_liability_notes: Relay is best-effort (no SLA). User can disable relay.

S.S1_cybersecurity: Encrypted relay (relay cannot read). Packet signing. Peer authentication.
S.S2_data_privacy: Relay nodes cannot see message content (encrypted).

X.X1_notes: Mesh protocol is key differentiator enabling offline operation. BLE + WiFi Direct for MVP. LoRa future enhancement. Field testing essential before launch.
X2_open_questions: Relay opt-in or opt-out? (opt-in = better privacy, lower coverage)
X.X3_related_research: BLE mesh networking. WiFi Direct. Offline-first architecture. LoRa range extension.
